name: TreasurySpring
description: Query your TreasurySpring portfolio directly from Claude. Check current and historical holdings, track upcoming maturities, browse available fixed-term funds, and generate portfolio reports using natural language. The integration inherits your existing TreasurySpring permissions and is strictly read-only. No transactions can be initiated, no data is used for model training, and every query is fully authenticated and audited. A faster way to reach the institutional cash data you already work with.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TreasurySpring to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TreasurySpring to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.treasuryspring.com/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TreasurySpring MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TreasurySpring lists 13 MCP tools, including get_cell, get_cells, get_entities, get_entity, get_holding, get_holding_extensions, get_holding_indications, get_holdings, get_indication, get_indications, get_obligor_exposure, and get_subscription.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TreasurySpring?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to TreasurySpring in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
TreasurySpring requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TreasurySpring is developed by TreasurySpring. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
